## Design Taste
*Source: http://localhost:4321/ — generated by /taste (re-run 2026-10-02 after the accent-color and scroll-photography changes). Full analysis: orbolo-localhost.md*

### Tokens
Colors: `#F8F4E9` (bg/68.6% of surface), `#516B3E` (text/fill/31.4% of surface), `#BFD55D` (accent — 0% of resting-state surface; interaction-only, see Directives). Radius: 16px (cards) / pill (buttons), no in-between. Spacing base: 8px; 80px is the dominant section break (64px also used for compact CTA sections).

### Directives
Reserve contrast for the interaction, not the resting page — the accent (`#BFD55D`) exists but must never appear in a resting/idle state: it's a hover fill and a flip-revealed border only, never a static background, never text (it measures 1.48:1 against cream — a knowing, Vaz-approved WCAG exception scoped strictly to non-text interaction fills, constitution 2026-09-30). Alignment is a mode-switch, not a preference: center for singular full-bleed statements (hero, section headings, footer), left for anything inside a bounded card/list. Two font weights only (400 body, 600 for short uppercase eyebrow labels) — hierarchy comes from size, not a weight ladder.

Photography now appears behind Home/Invest/Beef/Land hero sections and one further "choice point" section per page (final CTA, or the most literal "what you'd actually get" section) — always behind a flat cream wash (~58% opacity) so text keeps the same green-on-cream contrast it has everywhere else. Not every section gets a photo; alternating photo/plain-text sections is what keeps this from becoming a 3rd/4th resting-page contrast source.

### Anti-patterns
Never: per-audience accent colors, per-element margin (use container `gap`), an intermediate border-radius between 16px and pill, accent color on a `:focus-visible` ring (focus indicators are a functional affordance, not a decorative fill — they stay `#516B3E`, which passes contrast; `#BFD55D` against cream fails the 3:1 non-text/UI-component minimum outright), a photo behind more than 2–3 sections per page (photography marks a choice point, it isn't wallpaper).
